info.title: VG Select: 3A (Automated Agentic Architecture)
info.summary: Scans a repository and workload profile, then recommends an agentic application architecture that balances latency and accuracy.
info.description:
VG Select: 3A ranks ten agent topologies (single call, single agent, prompt chain, router, parallel sectioning, voting, evaluator-optimizer, orchestrator + workers, hierarchical, handoffs) using evidence-cited rules, estimates latency and cost for each, and produces a concrete orchestrator/subagent decomposition plan.

Typical flow: `POST /api/v1/scan` (or `/api/v1/scan/upload`) to infer a profile from code, review the inferred fields, then `POST /api/v1/recommend` with corrections.

path.description: Server-side directory to scan. Must be under one of VGSELECT_SCAN_ROOTS.

git_url.title: Git Url
git_url.description: Git URL to clone (shallow) and scan. Requires VGSELECT_ALLOW_GIT_CLONE=1.

overrides.description: Profile fields that override scan inferences.

recommend.title: Recommend
recommend.description: Also run the recommender on the merged profile.

allowed_providers.title: Allowed Providers
allowed_providers.description: Only these providers (e.g. anthropic, openai, google, self_hosted).

allowed_platforms.title: Allowed Platforms
allowed_platforms.description: Only models available on these platforms (anthropic_api, bedrock, vertex, foundry, openai_api, azure_openai, google_api, self_hosted).

regions.title: Regions
regions.description: Model must be served in at least one of these regions.

require_approved.title: Require Approved
require_approved.description: Exclude entries not approved by the platform team.

SelectionPolicyIn.title: SelectionPolicyIn
SelectionPolicyIn.description: Constraints on which catalog models may staff a role.

description.title: Description
description.description: One or two sentences describing what the application does.

task_complexity.title: Task Complexity
task_complexity.description: How much reasoning a single request needs. trivial: lookup/classification; simple: one-step generation; moderate: a few dependent steps; complex: many dependent steps with judgment; open_ended: the steps cannot be enumerated in advance.

steps_predictable.title: Steps Predictable
steps_predictable.description: Can the sequence of steps be fixed in code ahead of time (workflow) rather than decided by the model at run time (agent)?

scope_breadth.title: Scope Breadth
scope_breadth.description: Number of distinct domains or skill areas one request can span (e.g. code + security + docs = 3).

parallel_subtasks.title: Parallel Subtasks
parallel_subtasks.description: Typical number of independent sub-tasks in one request that could run at the same time (0 or 1 = none).

tool_count.title: Tool Count
tool_count.description: Number of distinct tools/functions available to the application.

tool_calls_per_task.title: Tool Calls Per Task
tool_calls_per_task.description: Expected average number of tool calls per request.

tool_dependency.title: Tool Dependency
tool_dependency.description: Are tool calls mostly sequential (each depends on the last), independent (can be issued together), or mixed?

tool_side_effects.title: Tool Side Effects
tool_side_effects.description: Worst-case side effect of the tools: read_only, reversible_writes (drafts, files under VCS), irreversible (send email, payments, deletes).

tool_overlap.title: Tool Overlap
tool_overlap.description: Do several tools have similar or overlapping purposes (so the model may pick the wrong one)? OpenAI's split trigger is overlap, not count.

tool_latency_s.title: Tool Latency S
tool_latency_s.description: Average wall-clock latency of one tool call in seconds.

knowledge_sources.title: Knowledge Sources
knowledge_sources.description: Number of distinct knowledge sources (vector stores, wikis, APIs, the web) that must be consulted.

retrieval_depth.title: Retrieval Depth
retrieval_depth.description: none: no retrieval; single_lookup: one query answers it; multi_hop: follow-up queries depend on earlier results; exhaustive: breadth-first coverage of a topic across many documents.

context_tokens_per_task.title: Context Tokens Per Task
context_tokens_per_task.description: Approximate tokens of documents/tool output that must be read to answer one request.

accuracy_priority.title: Accuracy Priority
accuracy_priority.description: 1 = best effort is fine ... 5 = errors are very costly (money, safety, compliance).

single_agent_baseline.title: Single Agent Baseline
single_agent_baseline.description: Measured accuracy (0.0-1.0) of a single agent/call on your eval, if you have one; -1 = not measured. Above ~0.45, adding agents tends to hurt.

verifiability.title: Verifiability
verifiability.description: Can an answer be checked objectively? none: purely subjective; partial: rubric/spot checks; strong: tests, schemas, ground truth.

error_recoverability.title: Error Recoverability
error_recoverability.description: How easily a wrong action can be caught and undone: easy (review before commit), moderate, hard (acts on the world immediately).

latency_budget_s.title: Latency Budget S
latency_budget_s.description: Target end-to-end latency for one request, in seconds (p50 is fine).

interaction.title: Interaction
interaction.description: single_turn: one request, one answer; multi_turn: conversational; long_running: one task spanning many minutes/hours.

cost_sensitivity.title: Cost Sensitivity
cost_sensitivity.description: 1 = cost is not a concern ... 5 = cost dominates the decision.

human_in_loop.title: Human In Loop
human_in_loop.description: Is a human available to approve risky actions during a request?

data_sensitivity.title: Data Sensitivity
data_sensitivity.description: Most sensitive class of data a request can contain. Only models cleared for this class in the catalog are eligible.

domains.title: Domains
domains.description: Names of the distinct domains/skill areas (used to name specialists).

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Names of the knowledge sources (used to name research workers).

subtasks.title: Subtasks
subtasks.description: Names of independent sub-tasks (used to name workers).

sections.title: Sections
sections.description: Names of independent sections for code-defined fan-out.
